risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and clearly attributes revenue, cost, liquidity, and operating impacts to COVID-19, including debt issuance, cost reductions, facility closures, and lower demand. Risk remains elevated because demand had not returned to pre-pandemic levels and management could not estimate the timing or duration of recovery. The discussion is complex and includes standard uncertainty language, but it is not strongly evasive.
